summary: The invitation tells the incoming member when the ceremony will actually begin.
realLife: Members elected to the 118th House waited through fifteen ballots for Speaker. Their swearing-in finally began at 1:40 on Saturday morning, four days after the House first met.
inGame: needs: a ceremony-specific hour rather than a generic day band.

turns.what: The clerk announces a delay before calling the incoming members forward.
turns.pulledBy: The preceding meeting still occupies the chamber.
turns.writesBack: Attendees receive a revised starting time.

turns.what: The family arrives in time for the opening gavel and has to leave for the last train before the oath.
turns.pulledBy: The invitation gives the opening hour, the Speaker election is still under way, and the family has a train to catch.
turns.writesBack: The journal records who saw the opening and leaves those relatives out of the oath scene.
